title: Strengthening Environmental & Social Framework (ESF) Capacity in Bangladesh and Bhutan-funded by the World Bank
summary: Building a Sustainable Learning Center at BUET.
body: Under the leadership of Prof. Dr. Md. Mafizur Rahman, the World Bank-funded project Strengthening Environmental & Social Framework (ESF) Capacity in Bangladesh and Bhutan established a standardized institutional, digital, and curricular engine that transformed isolated training workshops into a scalable, self-sustaining public sector safeguard learning hub.Initiated through the 2022 World Bank negotiations, the project established institutional governance, dedicated facilities, and a custom Moodle digital learning system backed by standardized operating protocols. Under Dr. Rahman's direction, the team authored contextualized ESF, OHS, GEMS, and bidding manuals, validating the curriculum through 2023 pilot professional courses and built-in feedback loops. This foundational infrastructure enabled seamless scaling across multi-batch technical workshops and self-sustaining nationwide initiatives, including the 61-district LGED training program.
